description: Inputs of the memory and bandwidth budget of the interface on the STM32H757 (tools/ui_budget.py reads it together with docs/platform_profiles.json, src/ui_h757/spec/i18n.json and src/ui_h757/spec/ui_spec.json and computes the rest). Every number says where it comes from: `data` is computed from the files of this repository, `published` is the figure the project of the library states, `estimate` is a value of this design that a measurement in the CI or on the board replaces. Nothing here was measured on a board.

stack.version_policy: a release of the 9.x series, pinned by commit in the firmware build when the driver phase starts

flash_bytes.note: the project states about 200-300 kB of flash for a typical interface; the upper figure is used

ram_bytes.note: the project states about 100 kB of RAM for a typical interface, plus the render buffer

render_buffer_fraction.note: the project asks for a render buffer of at least 1/10 of the screen

layer_bytes_per_pixel.note: RGB565 layers; the DSI link carries the pixels of the panel in its own format

refresh_hz.note: docs of the board: 60 Hz does not fit two lanes with margin, 30 Hz is the experimental candidate

display.panel_native_orientation: portrait 720x1280, used as landscape: the rotation is a cost the driver phase has to settle (LTDC does not rotate)

sdclk_hz.note: HCLK 200 MHz with SDCLK period 2 (the CubeMX values are starting values)

sustained_fraction.note: share of the peak a mix of scan-out, DMA2D and CPU keeps

scanout_max_fraction.note: the scan-out of the display may take at most this share of the sustained bandwidth

fonts.note: uncompressed bitmap glyphs of full-width cell for the CJK scripts and half-width for the Latin ones: an upper bound; the glyphs counted are exactly the characters of src/ui_h757/spec/i18n.json

cm7_app_reserve_bytes.note: what the brain application of the CM7 needs besides the interface (CAN stack, kinematics, SPI link); replaced by the size of the real build

internal_flash.proposed_note: bank 1 from 0x08040000 to the end of the bank (0x08100000): the profile gives the CM7 application 384 KiB and leaves the rest of the bank unassigned; the change belongs to the profile of the H757 and waits for its owner

axi_core_state_bytes.note: ui_state_t, the render buffer bookkeeping and the stack of the interface task

task_stack_bytes.note: stack of the interface task; the stop path does not run in it

external_assets.note: the GD25Q128E on SPI5 is not memory mapped: fonts and images are copied from it into the SDRAM at start, after their hash is checked

ui_core.note: limits the CI holds the build of src/ui_h757/core/ui_core.c for the Cortex-M7 to (arm-none-eabi-gcc -Os); the measured size is printed by the test
